spans.s:
(इ) जिगि r. 1st cl. (जुंगति)
1 To except, to exclude.
2 To quit or abandon.

n. (-नं)
Censure, abuse, reproach, reviling.
E.
गुप to censure, affix ल्युट्, or with अङ् and टाप् affixes जुगुप्सा; the root is always inflected in this sense, in the desiderative form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reviled, blamed, censured, abused.
E.
गुप to censure, affix क्त.
